title: Anzac Biscuits
description: Chewy in the middle, crisp at the edge. The golden syrup is what makes them, so do not skimp on it.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays.
Combine the oats, flour, coconut and sugar in a large bowl.
Melt the butter and golden syrup together in a small saucepan over a low heat.
Dissolve the baking soda in the boiling water and stir it into the melted butter. It will froth up.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and mix until it holds together when squeezed.
Roll walnut-sized balls, space them well apart on the trays and flatten each one lightly. They spread.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden. Leave them on the tray for five minutes to firm up before moving them.

notes: Pull them out while the centres still look slightly underdone if you want them chewy. Another two minutes gives you the crisp version.

nutrition.assumptions: Estimated from ingredient composition. About 690 g of raw mixture baking down to roughly 530 g, divided into 24 biscuits of about 22 g each. Unsalted butter assumed.
